sql.attachmentType.getTypesForCompany: select * from flow.attachment_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true
sql.attachmentType.getAvailableTypesForProce: select at.* from flow.attachment_type at where at.archived is not true and at.company_id = :companyId and not exists ( select process_step_id from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat where psat.attachment_type_id = at.id and psat.process_step_id = :id and archived is not true ) order by at.attachment_type
sql.attachmentType.getProcessStepType: SELECT psat.id, psat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", psat.created_by_id as "createdById", psat.process_step_id as "processStepId", psat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", psat.archived FROM flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where psat.id = :id
sql.attachmentType.insertProcessStepType: insert into flow.process_step_attachment_type (attachment_type_id, process_step_id, created_by_id, date_created) values (:attachmentTypeId, :processStepId, :createdById, now())
sql.attachmentType.getType: select id, attachment_type, company_id, archived from flow.attachment_type where company_id = :companyId and id = :typeId order by attachment_type.attachment_type;
sql.attachmentType.deleteProcessStepType: update flow.process_step_attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.deleteType: update flow.attachment_type set archived = true where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.updateType: update flow.attachment_type set attachment_type = :attachmentType where id = :id
